thread:
oliver (AE): Incoming SIG v3 from AuroraMed, attached to CRM. They asked for completed SIG + SOC2 excerpt before POC kickoff next Thu. Link: https://files.redwood/auroramed/sig.pdf

devops-bot: Intake created SR-8120 -> security-review queue.

ana (sales-ops): pinging security - can someone claim? Need a short controls summary for the POC.

rachel (security): I'll take it. Quick clarifier: will the POC process customer data or synthetic only?

oliver (AE): POC is synthetic only. They did ask about BYOK and VPC options for production.

rachel (security): For SIG answers we'll note BYOK available in Private, envelope encryption on hosted, key rotation quarterly. If they want BYOK during POC that's additional setup (+2 weeks).

ana (sales-ops): NDA needed before SOC2 share? Customer said they'd sign.

oliver (AE): Sent NDA earlier today. Waiting on signature.

rachel (security): I'll draft answers focusing on high-risk controls (KMS, network, incident response). ETA tomorrow EOD.

devops-bot: SR-8120 assigned -> rachel (security).

rachel (security): Draft uploaded to intake folder: https://files.redwood/auroramed/sig-draft.docx. Once NDA is signed I'll attach redacted SOC2 and mark SR-8120 ready for customer.

oliver (AE): NDA signed by customer. Please attach SOC2 redacted when ready.

rachel (security): Attached SOC2 summary. Marking SR-8120 -> ready for customer. No POC blockers for synthetic-only. Recommend Private for PHI/production.

ana (sales-ops): Thanks, updating CRM and closing intake.

oliver (AE): Great, we'll share during kickoff. :thumbsup:
